Successor of Taiwu, do not neglect..."

8859aa62-7cbf-4fc4-b658-89f46f6fcebb/Eve.en: "Xiangshu Underlings are no ordinary demons; wherever they go, Blackstone grows abundantly,<NL><color=#orange>only the Successor of Taiwu can completely exterminate them</color>,<NL>we can only barely stop them, but cannot eliminate the lingering threat..."
